task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-05 at src/design/adp-05-instance-artifact-hash.md. Define the additive instance schema update for a nullable definition_artifact_hash TEXT column and specify when instance creation must persist the definition version artifact hash versus leaving NULL for pre-repository compatibility. Describe repository and replay/state-reconstruction contracts that prefer artifact-hash reconstruction when available while preserving PD-08 snapshot fallback behavior for legacy instances. Include migration semantics, nullability/backfill rules, invariants linking definition snapshots to artifact hashes, and concrete testability notes for new-instance persistence plus replay compatibility. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines additive ADP-05 schema semantics for instance.definition_artifact_hash with backward compatibility
Instance start/write-path rules specify when the artifact hash is populated and when NULL remains valid
Replay and state-reconstruction behavior explicitly covers artifact-hash-first reconstruction with PD-08 snapshot fallback
Migration and data-compatibility behavior for pre-repository rows is explicit and testable
Design includes traceability to PD-08, EE-01, REPO-01, and IR-02 with concrete testability notes

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-05 instance artifact hash with additive schema semantics, explicit start-path hash/null persistence rules, artifact-hash-first reconstruction with PD-08 snapshot fallback, migration compatibility/nullability constraints, and traceability-backed testability notes.
